Normalizes the points of a las file over an elevation model, turning their elevations into heights over the ground, or the other way around.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › utilities<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** las, dem<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.lesto.modules.utilities.LasElevationHandler`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inFile` | LAS file |  |  | The las file to handle. |
| `inDtm` | raster file |  |  | The elevation model of the ground. |
| `doAdd` | boolean |  | `false` | If set to true, the dtm value is added to the las elevation, instead of subtracted. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outFile` | output file |  | The normalized las file. |
